description:
Notice of Intent to Sole Source
                                                              Laundry Detergent Feed System
The Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP), Fleet Logistics Center Jacksonville
(FLCJ), FL intends to issue a sole source award for the procurement of laundry detergent
feed system and chemicals to be provided for the commercial washers at Unaccompanied
Housing Corry Station, FL; Center for Information Dominance (CID) to Charles Neely
Corporation. The contractor shall provide and maintain the laundry feed system, which
includes four pumps, four front-load dispensers, a controller (machine interface), J-cables
(963300), a chemical dispenser, with built-in load count feature to track and document
wash loads, chemicals dispensed, wash levels, and wash times. The system must be
compatible with the particular washing machines Model SP100E2 25 ANN-ABA B&C
Technologies. The equipment is proprietary to Charles Neely Corporation. The applicable
North American Industrial Classification System Code (NAICS) code that this work falls
under is 811310, Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and
Electronic) Repair and Maintenance, with a Small Business Size of $12.5M. This notice of
intent is for information purposes only. All sources eligible to provide this requirement
must respond in writing. Responses must be supported with clear and convincing
evidence to clearly articulate the ability to provide this requirement as outlined above. A
request for documentation will not be considered as an affirmative response. If no
responses are received, within 15 calendar days after publication of this notice, to the
effect that comparable items are available, and that it is more advantageous to the
Government than obtaining this product through a sole-source contract, then a sole source
acquisition award will be made. Response to this notice is to be sent to the contract
specialist Quentin Keaton at Quentin.l.keaton.civ@us.navy.mil and contracting officer
Peiney Allerton at peiney.t.allerton.civ@us.navy.mil .
